title: The König constant is one
summary: For each $N\geq1$, consider the normalized König bilinear form $B_{\mathrm K}:L_\infty(\mathbb R^N)\times L_\infty(\mathbb R^N)\to\mathbb R$ given by \[ B_{\mathrm K}(f,g):=\frac{1}{(\sqrt{2}π)^N} \iint_{\mathbb R^N\times\mathbb R^N} f(x)g(y)e^{-(\lVert x\rVert^2+\lVert y\rVert^2)/2} \sin\langle x,y\rangle\,\mathrm d x\,\mathrm d y, \] We define the König constant by \[ \mathfrak K_{\mathrm K}:=\sup_{N\geq1}\sup_{\substack{f,g:\mathbb R^N\to\{\pm1\}\\ f,g\ \mathrm{measurable}}}B_{\mathrm K}(f,g). \] The study of this bilinear form arose from efforts to determine the exact value of the…
